title: 第13章 法赛第14章 准备和新工作
content_zh:
这天的法力课上，示范班的学生正盘坐在静室之中运转着吐纳法。
前方的摄像头则监控着学生们的一举一动，将学生们有没有睁眼，有没有挠痒，有没有动手动脚，有没有屁股扭来扭去……任何轻微的异状都会被一一记录下来。
而所有这些数据会被统一记录为走神率。
每周走神率最高的班级，会被全校通报批评。
示范班的学生对此不以为意，反正不论怎么考核，他们班也必然是第一。
而每周走神率最低的学生，不但会被通报表扬，更是会被奖励500块钱，以及一小时天灵根的免费租用权。
这就让示范班的学生们一个个提起了神来。
而张羽第一次在脑海里知道走神率这玩意的存在，便感叹如果前世有这个东西，学生们必然会骂学校大傻逼。
但这个世界却不一样，示范班的学生们个个像是发情的公牛一样盯着每天的走神率，整个班级里都充满了一股激烈的卷气。
此时此刻，伴随着一阵铃响，静室内默默运功的众人都停了下来，将目光看向了前方的大屏幕，期待着这节课的走神率数据。
第1名张羽走神率0%法力83
第2名白真真走神率003%法力112
第3名钱深走神率012%法力111
……
看着这走神率的排名，教室内的学生们虽然没有出声，但从他们眼神和表情的细微变化中，能感觉到一丝丝的惊讶在蔓延。
台上法力课的指导老师姓严，是一名盘着头带着黑框眼镜的女老师。
此刻便听这位严老师看着大屏幕上的成绩说道“走神率超过03%的几位同学，我今天也不点名了。”
“已经开学三个月了，我说了多少次冥心于一，合气于淡？”
“走神率这么高，你们的吐纳效率怎么可能比得上别人？”
“大家都是一天修炼24个小时，你们不会比别人多出时间来，吐纳效率低了以后，一天落后个一点点，高中三年后你们在法力上的差距可能就是10点、20点甚至30点。”

“还有我说了多少次了，走神率降不下来的同学，可以来我办公室买静心剂，昨天我下午在办公室坐了三个小时，没一个人来问我的……是都觉得自己一点问题没有了？！”
一番批评后，严老师又微微一笑，看着屏幕上的前几名说道“当然，也有表现很好的同学。”
“这里点名表扬一下走神率最低的三名同学，特别是张羽，已经连续4天走神率0%了，对比以前，可谓是质的飞跃。”
“还有法力这三天也提升了足足05点，说明他在课外时间也一定下足了苦功，不是租了灵根，就是租了高灵机的修炼室，是吧张羽同学？”
所有学生们目光立刻全都看了过去。
却见张羽仍旧双目紧闭，看上去似睡非睡，还在继续默默运转周天采气法。
严老师赞赏道“你们看，这就是真正学霸的态度，下课了都不停，抓紧每一分每一秒的时间去修炼，去变强。”
赵天行看着还在认真吐纳的张羽，发现自己越来越看不懂这位同学了“明明是这么用功的人，为什么体育课上反而要偷懒不扎药呢？”
白真真看着仍旧紧闭双目的张羽，心道“羽子这几天除了吃饭拉屎，就差走路的时候没吐纳了，用功到了这种地步……难道是被70万的催债电话逼出来的？。”
台上，严老师继续说道“当然了，所谓一分钱一分收获，仙道之路上没有免费的东西，不砸钱是走不长远的，最近学校里的天灵根租借有了空位，感兴趣的同学可以来找我。”
而在严老师离开之前，她说的一件事情却是引起了张羽的注意。
“对了，市里的法赛下个月要开始了，高一组基本上全市所有高中都会参加，第一名的奖金有10万……”
“因为比赛下周五报名，所以高一年级里，学校打算在下周五挑选法力水平前十的学生参加法赛……”
……
当天晚上，食堂。
周天翊今天要提前赶去补习班，餐桌上此刻只留下了张羽和白真真。
被白真真左看右看，看得有些受不了了，张羽开口说道“阿真，我知道自己的颜值很高，在这只知道学习的嵩阳高中里犹如是鹤立鸡群，但你也不用这么死盯着看吧。”
白真真问道“你说你也想参加法赛？”
“可惜了，阿真。”张羽摇摇头道“你这位年级第一的绝世天才如果不是我的朋友，接下来就该向我挑衅一番，接着在赛场上被我的惊人表现连番打脸，最后瞳孔地震几十级了。”
白真真摇了摇头“羽子，你想参加的可是全市法力竞赛啊。”

“那是整个嵩阳市所有高中，派出自己最优秀，法力最雄厚，家里最有钱的学生来参赛，汇聚了无数的死有钱人。”
白真真一脸感慨地说道“像你这样的普通人去参加会是怎么样的结果？”
content_en:
In today's magic class, the students in the demonstration class were sitting cross-legged in the quiet room and performing the breathing and breathing method.
The camera in front monitors every move of the students, whether they open their eyes, scratch themselves, move their hands or feet, squirm their buttocks... any slight abnormality will be recorded one by one.
All these data will be uniformly recorded as the mind-wandering rate.
The class with the highest concentration rate each week will be criticized by the whole school.
The students in the demonstration class didn't care about this. No matter how they were assessed, their class would definitely be number one.
The student with the lowest mind-wandering rate each week will not only be notified and praised, but will also be awarded 500 yuan and the right to rent a one-hour Tianlingen free of charge.
This made the students in the demonstration class get excited one by one.
For the first time, Zhang Yu knew the existence of the mind-wandering rate thing in his mind, and lamented that if this thing existed in his previous life, the students would definitely call the school a fool.
But this world is different. The students in the demonstration class are all like bulls in heat staring at their daily distraction rate, and the whole class is filled with a fierce atmosphere.
At this moment, with the sound of a bell ringing, everyone in the quiet room who was silently practicing kung fu stopped and looked at the big screen in front of them, looking forward to the data on the distraction rate of this class.
No. 1 Zhang Yu’s distraction rate is 0% and his mana is 83
No. 2 Bai Zhenzhen has a distraction rate of 003% and a mana of 112
No. 3 Qian Shen’s distraction rate 012%, mana 111
…
Looking at the ranking of distraction rates, although the students in the classroom did not make a sound, they could feel a trace of surprise spreading from the subtle changes in their eyes and expressions.
The instructor in the magic class on the stage is named Yan. She is a female teacher with her hair tied up and wearing black-rimmed glasses.
At this moment, Teacher Yan looked at the results on the big screen and said, "I won't name the students whose mindfulness rate exceeds 03% today."
"It's been three months since school started. How many times have I told you to meditate on one's mind and keep your energy calm?"
"With such a high mind-wandering rate, how can your breathing efficiency be as good as others?"
"Everyone practices 24 hours a day. You won't have more time than others. After the breathing efficiency is low, you will fall behind a little bit every day. After three years of high school, the gap in your mana may be 10 points, 20 points or even 30 points."
"Also, how many times have I told you that students who can't reduce their mind-wandering rate can come to my office to buy tranquilizers. I sat in the office for three hours yesterday afternoon, and no one came to ask me... Do you think you have no problem at all?!"
After some criticism, Teacher Yan smiled slightly, looked at the first few students on the screen and said, "Of course, there are also students who performed very well."
"Here I would like to name and commend the three students with the lowest mind-wandering rate. Especially Zhang Yu, whose mind-wandering rate has been 0% for 4 consecutive days. Compared with before, it can be said to be a qualitative leap."
"Also, his mana has increased by a full 05 points in the past three days, which shows that he must have worked hard outside of class. He either rented spiritual roots or rented Gao Lingji's training room, right, classmate Zhang Yu?"
All the students looked over immediately.
However, Zhang Yu's eyes were still closed, looking like he was sleeping but not sleeping, and he continued to silently operate the Zhoutian Qi Collection Technique.
Teacher Yan praised, "You see, this is the attitude of a true academic master. He doesn't stop even after class, and seizes every minute and every second to practice and become stronger."
Zhao Tianxing looked at Zhang Yu, who was still talking seriously, and found that he could not understand this classmate more and more. "You are obviously such a hardworking person, why do you have to be lazy and not take medicine in physical education class?"
Bai Zhenzhen looked at Zhang Yu, who still had his eyes closed, and thought to himself, "In addition to eating and pooping in the past few days, Yuzi has only stopped breathing when walking. After studying to this extent...could he be forced out by the 700,000 debt collection call?"
On the stage, Teacher YanHe continued, "Of course, as the saying goes, you get what you pay for. There is nothing free on the road to immortality. You can't go far without spending money. Recently, there are vacancies in the school's Tianlinggen rental. Interested students can come to me."
But before Teacher Yan left, one thing she said caught Zhang Yu's attention.
"By the way, the city's law competition will start next month. Basically all the high schools in the city will participate in the upper group. The prize for the first place is 100,000..."
"Since registration for the competition is next Friday, the school plans to select the top ten students in the magic level to participate in the competition next Friday in the first grade of high school..."
…
That night, the cafeteria.
Zhou Tianyi had to rush to cram school early today, and only Zhang Yu and Bai Zhenzhen were left at the dining table.
Bai Zhenzhen was looking at her left and right, and it was a bit unbearable. Zhang Yu said, "Azhen, I know that I have a very good appearance. I am like a standout in Songyang High School, which only knows how to study, but you don't have to stare at me like this."
Bai Zhenzhen asked, "You said you also want to participate in the Fa competition?"
"What a pity, Ah Zhen." Zhang Yu shook his head and said, "If you, the peerless genius who is number one in your grade, were not my friend, you would have challenged me, and then you would have been repeatedly slapped in the face by my amazing performance on the field. In the end, your pupils were shaken by dozens of levels."
Bai Zhenzhen shook his head, "Yuzi, what you want to participate in is the city's magic competition."
"All the high schools in Songyang City sent their best, most powerful, and richest students to compete, and countless wealthy people gathered together."
Bai Zhenzhen said with emotion, "What will happen if an ordinary person like you participates?"
